# Community room booking

The community room is booked through the desk or the online form, no earlier
than 90 days and no later than 3 open days ahead. A booking is confirmed only
when the confirmation email arrives; a submitted form is not a booking.

Bookings are free for constituted community groups and 18.00 an hour otherwise.
A group that cancels less than 48 hours ahead is charged the full hourly rate
regardless of category, and a group that fails to appear twice in a year loses
the free rate for 12 months.

The room is available during opening hours only and must be cleared 15 minutes
before close. Food is allowed; amplified sound is not, because the room shares a
wall with the quiet study area.

The room seats 40 laid out in rows and 24 around tables. The layout is set by
the booking group, and the room must be returned to rows.
